text: Yehiree -onon gomɗimɓe ɓen- ka jihaadi ka neweende maa ka saɗteende, foti ko on sukaaɓe maa nayeeɓe, tiiɗnoron jawle mon e wonkiiji mon. Ko ngol yaltugol tiiɗnora jawle e wonki ɗon ɓuri wonande on e nafa aduan e laakara diini humondiro e kisal jawle maa wonkii, si on laatike annduɓe ɗum, rerdee e mum.
